Named OpenConnector connection (e.g. 'bron-rod', 'oso', 'leerplicht', 'surfconext', 'hr', 'swv', 'ooapi-catalog', 'timetable-import'). 'swv' routes a zorgvraag/TLV-chain dossier (learning-plan's SupportRequest) to the regional samenwerkingsverband (openconnector#753). 'ooapi-catalog' syncs a published/archived Course, Programme, or Cohort to the OOAPI 5.0 course catalog hosted by opencatalogi, per the course-management publication contract (course → course, program → program, offering → offering). 'timetable-import' (direction:import) hands a generated-timetable pull to the OpenConnector Zermelo/Untis/Xedule source configuration; TimetableImportHandler resolves the response via the matching DataMappingProfile into idempotent Session upserts keyed by externalRef, then triggers TimetableConflictDetector's batch scan (timetabling-and-substitution). 'oso' with direction:import receives an incoming PO→VO overstapdossier; the matching DataMappingProfile resolves it into an OsoImportDossier held for coordinator review before acceptance (oso-inbound-contract) — the existing direction:export path (OsoDossierReviewGuard's parent-review gate) is unchanged. Learniq implements no Edukoppeling/StUF/OSO-XML/Digikoppeling/SAML/OOAPI/Zermelo/Untis/Xedule wire code — all protocol logic lives in OpenConnector.

Named OpenConnector connection (e.g. 'bron-rod', 'oso', 'leerplicht', 'surfconext', 'hr', 'swv', 'ooapi-catalog', 'timetable-import', 'migration-import', 'lvs-results', 'uwlr', 'edu-v', 'basispoort', 'entree-content'). 'swv' routes a zorgvraag/TLV-chain dossier (learning-plan's SupportRequest) to the regional samenwerkingsverband (openconnector#753). 'ooapi-catalog' syncs a published/archived Course, Programme, or Cohort to the OOAPI 5.0 course catalog hosted by opencatalogi, per the course-management publication contract (course → course, program → program, offering → offering). 'timetable-import' (direction:import) hands a generated-timetable pull to the OpenConnector Zermelo/Untis/Xedule/TimeEdit source configuration; TimetableImportHandler resolves the response via the matching DataMappingProfile into idempotent Session upserts keyed by externalRef, then triggers TimetableConflictDetector's batch scan (timetabling-and-substitution). 'migration-import' (direction:import) hands a one-time ParnasSys/ESIS/Magister/SOMtoday SIS-migration pull to the OpenConnector source configuration; the matching DataMappingProfile resolves the incoming record onto LearnerProfile (data-mapping-profile-presets). 'lvs-results' (direction:import) hands a UWLR-carried Cito/IEP/Boom/Dia normed-result pull to the OpenConnector source configuration; the matching DataMappingProfile maps the incoming record onto LvsResult, which lands as 'imported' and awaits coordinator verification (lvs-import-contract). 'oso' with direction:import receives an incoming PO→VO overstapdossier; the matching DataMappingProfile resolves it into an OsoImportDossier held for coordinator review before acceptance (oso-inbound-contract). The existing direction:export path (OsoDossierReviewGuard's parent-review gate) is unchanged. 'uwlr' (direction:export) sends pupil/group/teacher data carrying eckId to publishers/test suppliers, and (direction:import) receives generic results back (deliberately mapped onto LvsResult, see the lvs-results target, rather than a second results schema). 'edu-v' (direction:export) sends the same kind of pupil/group/teacher data through Edu-V's qualified-per-data-service afsprakenstelsel instead of/alongside UWLR. 'basispoort' (direction:sync) is the PO-only SSO-plus-export hand-off to method/publisher content; 'entree-content' (direction:sync) is VO's Entree-based equivalent (uwlr-eduv-basispoort-contract). Both are distinct from 'surfconext', which is learniq's OWN federated login concern, not a hand-off to a third party. Learniq implements no Edukoppeling/StUF/OSO-XML/Digikoppeling/SAML/OOAPI/Zermelo/Untis/Xedule/TimeEdit/UWLR/Edu-V/Basispoort/Entree wire code: all protocol logic lives in OpenConnector.
